WITH w AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY'
              WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'CY' END AS win, *
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
)
SELECT win, channel_code,
  count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
  sum(net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS staff_net,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN win IS NULL THEN NULL END) x,
  min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_etl, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_etl,
  count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS etl_n,
  sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_lines,
  min(sale_date) AS mind, max(sale_date) AS maxd, count(DISTINCT sale_date) AS days
FROM w WHERE win IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH st AS (SELECT store_key, store_id FROM dim_store),
s AS (
  SELECT st.store_id,
    CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'CY' END AS win,
    sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS sale_days
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN st USING (store_key)
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
  GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (
  SELECT st.store_id,
    CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'CY' END AS win,
    sum(r.refund_net) AS ret_net, count(*) AS n_ret, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS n_ret_dist
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN st USING (store_key)
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
  GROUP BY 1,2),
p AS (
  SELECT store_id,
    CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'CY' END AS win,
    sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net, count(*) AS rpt_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT s.store_id, s.win, s.sale_days, s.sales_net, r.ret_net, r.n_ret, r.n_ret_dist, p.rpt_days, p.rpt_gross, p.rpt_ret, p.rpt_net
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (store_id, win) LEFT JOIN p USING (store_id, win)
ORDER BY s.store_id, s.win DESC

WITH cur_store AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_name, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
),
store_week AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, 'PY' AS win, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT st.store_id, 'CY', f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT st.store_id, 'PY', -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT st.store_id, 'CY', -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
),
per_store AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(CASE WHEN win='PY' THEN amt END) AS py, sum(CASE WHEN win='CY' THEN amt END) AS cy
  FROM store_week GROUP BY store_id
),
j AS (SELECT c.region, c.store_id, p.py, p.cy FROM cur_store c JOIN per_store p USING (store_id))
SELECT region,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139) THEN cy END)/sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139) THEN py END)-1),2) AS base,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (136,137,139) THEN cy END)/sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (136,137,139) THEN py END)-1),2) AS excl_136,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137) THEN cy END)/sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137) THEN py END)-1),2) AS incl_139,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139,129) THEN cy END)/sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139,129) THEN py END)-1),2) AS excl_129,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139,119) THEN cy END)/sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139,119) THEN py END)-1),2) AS excl_119,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (139) THEN cy END)/sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (139) THEN py END)-1),2) AS incl_137,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139) THEN py END),2) AS base_py, round(sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139) THEN cy END),2) AS base_cy,
  count(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (137,139) THEN 1 END) AS n_base
FROM j GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

WITH windows AS (
  SELECT 'PY' AS win, DATE '2024-10-28' AS d0, DATE '2025-01-26' AS d1
  UNION ALL SELECT 'CY', DATE '2025-10-27', DATE '2026-01-25'
),
-- current version of each store: restated region, used for both years
cur_store AS (
  SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
),
-- trading days per window (stores shut by law or company rule excluded)
trading AS (
  SELECT w.win, d.calendar_date FROM windows w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date BETWEEN w.d0 AND w.d1 WHERE d.is_trading_day
),
-- store sales by day, store identity via store_id (store versions collapsed)
sales_day AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2
),
returns_day AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, r.return_date AS d, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2
),
-- store x window: net sales after returns and number of trading days that have sales
store_win AS (
  SELECT c.store_id, c.region, w.win,
    coalesce((SELECT sum(sales) FROM sales_day s WHERE s.store_id=c.store_id AND s.d BETWEEN w.d0 AND w.d1),0)
    - coalesce((SELECT sum(refunds) FROM returns_day r WHERE r.store_id=c.store_id AND r.d BETWEEN w.d0 AND w.d1),0) AS net_sales,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading t WHERE t.win=w.win AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_day s WHERE s.store_id=c.store_id AND s.d=t.calendar_date)) AS trading_days_without_sales
  FROM cur_store c CROSS JOIN windows w
),
-- like-for-like store test: open before PY window starts, not closed before CY window ends, no refit closure
-- touching either window, and sales on every trading day in both windows
eligible AS (
  SELECT c.store_id FROM cur_store c JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=c.store_id AND s.is_current
  WHERE (s.open_date IS NULL OR s.open_date <= DATE '2024-10-28')
    AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date >= DATE '2026-01-25')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure z JOIN windows w ON z.closure_start_date <= w.d1 AND z.closure_end_date >= w.d0 WHERE z.store_id=c.store_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_win v WHERE v.store_id=c.store_id AND v.trading_days_without_sales > 0)
)
SELECT v.region,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN win='CY' THEN net_sales END)/sum(CASE WHEN win='PY' THEN net_sales END)-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM store_win v JOIN eligible e USING (store_id)
GROUP BY v.region ORDER BY v.region
